name: mdm-download-manager
description: MDM - Mohamed Download Manager, a modern, original download manager for Windows
author: MDM Contributors

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -n VITE,MAIN,APP -c cyan,magenta,green "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist/main/main/index.js && cross-env MDM_DEV=1 VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:extension
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis && npm run smoke:fuses
scripts.package:signed: node scripts/require-signing-env.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.signed.yml && npm run smoke:fuses
